A. History and Development of the Company
We are a global smart wearable and health technology leader. Since our inception in 2013, we have established a strong global presence, particularly in Europe and the U.S. To date, we have shipped over 200 million units of smart wearable devices and served more than 53 million users in over 90 countries with device activation in more than 150 countries.
In December 2013, we commenced our operations in China with a focus on developing, manufacturing and selling smart wearable devices. A year later, in December 2014, we incorporated Zepp Health Corporation, previously knowns as Huami Corporation, in the Cayman Islands as our offshore holding company to facilitate financing and offshore listing. On February 8, 2018, our ADSs commenced trading on the NYSE under the symbol “HMI.”
In February 2021, we, through Anhui Shunyuan Xinke Management Consulting Partnership (Limited Partnership), one of our subsidiaries in China, acquired 29.99% of the total outstanding shares of Jiangsu Yitong, a PRC company listed in Shenzhen Stock Exchange, for an aggregate consideration of US$144.89 million in cash to expand the healthcare ecosystem for Chinese market in the long term. The transaction was completed in February 2021. In May 2022, we, through Anhui Shunyuan Xinke Management Consulting Partnership (Limited Partnership), acquired another 0.01% of the total outstanding shares of Jiangsu Yitong for an aggregate consideration of US$35,238.
In February 2021, we rebranded ourselves from “Huami Corporation” to “Zepp Health Corporation” to emphasize our global recognition and expansion efforts. As part of this rebranding, we changed our trading symbol at the New York Stock Exchange from “HMI” to “ZEPP.”
Our branding journey started in September 2015 when we started to use the brand name “Amazfit” to market our products, followed by the launch of the “Zepp” brand in August 2020 to broaden our portfolio. In March 2022 and August 2022, we launched Zepp Clarity, a hearing aid solution, and Zepp Aura, a mindfulness app, using personalized AI-powered soundscape to help users sleep, rest, and focus better, respectively.
On September 16, 2024, we effected an ADS ratio change to adjust our ordinary share to ADS ratio from one ADS representing four Class A ordinary shares to one ADS representing 16 Class A ordinary shares.
In August 2024, we commenced a two-year partnership with HYROX, the World Series of Fitness Racing. In April 2026, we entered into a new three-year global partnership with HYROX as its exclusive wearable technology provider, significantly expanding the previous regional collaboration into a worldwide agreement.

B. Business Overview
We are a global smart wearable and health technology leader with operations in Europe, the U.S. and Asia. We empower users to achieve their well-being goals by optimizing their health, fitness, and wellness journeys through our leading consumer brands: Amazfit, Zepp Clarity, and Zepp Aura. Amazfit is a brand of smartwatches and wearables designed for various fitness levels and lifestyles, offering rich product offerings and full price-range coverage; Zepp Clarity offers discreet, AI-powered hearing aids to combat hearing loss; and Zepp Aura provides personalized, AI-generated soundscapes to improve sleep and relaxation. Our mission is to empower individuals to take control of their well-being through intelligent healthcare tools, and to create a world where healthcare is a source of empowerment, inspiration, and joy for all.
Powered by our proprietary digital health management platform, which includes the Zepp OS—a proprietary operating system with high compatibility, scalability, and seamless application integration—AI chips, biometric sensors, hardware, and specialized health data algorithms, we deliver cloud-based actionable insights and guidance 24/7 to help users achieve their health goals. Our proprietary HuangShan 3 chip and biosensors leverage a cutting-edge open-source RISC-V architecture that delivers high performance at low cost. We have further enhanced our platform through generative AI solutions, including Zepp Flow, Zepp Coach, Zepp Aura, and Food Log features, which provide faster, more responsive user experiences at lower cost. Our devices deliver industry-leading GPS and heart-rate accuracy, long battery life and extended GPS operation time, advanced free offline maps, and comprehensive workout models with professional-level data across activities such as golf, free diving, and more. We maintain an integrated device, chip, and cloud strategy that supports a fast innovation cycle relative to the industry norm of over one year. We also maintain strong privacy protections, with compliance under GDPR and HIPAA frameworks and data stored on AWS infrastructure. We have also applied our AI expertise to emerging industrial medical imaging technologies delivering big data and analytics capabilities to support medical and diagnostics care service providers.
Since our inception in 2013, we have established a strong global presence, particularly in Europe and the U.S., supported by our own global sales channel and distribution network, a vertically integrated supply chain with multi-sourcing capabilities, and a localized talent base led by a globally experienced management team. To date, we have shipped over 200 million units of smart wearable devices and served more than 53 million users in over 90 countries with device activation in more than 150 countries. With outstanding craftsmanship, Amazfit smartwatches have won many design awards, including the iF Design Award and the Red Dot Design Award, reflecting our award-winning, industry-leading design philosophy and our commitment to ESG principles and sustainability. We are trusted by top athletes and have partnered with massively popular sport organizations such as HYROX, while benefiting from a flourishing third-party partner community and world-leading software ecosystem integrations, including Strava and TrainingPeaks.
Our Products and Services
Our key product and service offerings consist of (i) smart bands and smart watches, our core hardware products sold primarily under the Amazfit and Zepp brands, (ii) ecosystem products, including smart rings, hearables, the Helio Strap, smart scales, and accessories, and (iii) software and data services, including Zepp Aura, our AI-powered sound health platform, and our data analytics capabilities.
Smart Bands and Smart Watches
We have developed a wide range of smart wearable devices that offer robust features at competitive price points, sold primarily under our proprietary Amazfit and Zepp brand names. Our product portfolio spans multiple form factors and styles, including round and rectangular display configurations, and targets a broad range of consumer use cases, from ruggedized outdoor and sports-oriented devices to fashion-forward and everyday lifestyle wearables.

Risks Related to Our Corporate Structure
●
We are a Cayman Islands holding company with no equity ownership in the VIEs and we conduct our operations in China through (i) our PRC subsidiaries and (ii) the VIEs with which we have maintained contractual arrangements and their subsidiaries. Investors in our Class A ordinary shares or the ADSs thus are not purchasing equity interest in the VIEs in China but instead are purchasing equity interest in a Cayman Islands holding company. If the PRC government finds that the agreements that establish the structure for operating some of our operations in China do not comply with PRC regulations relating to the relevant industries, or if these regulations or the interpretation of existing regulations change in the future, we could be subject to severe penalties or be forced to relinquish our interests in those operations.
